import asyncio


async def break_outer(pages, items, session, save, cursor):
    for page in pages:
        async with session():
            for item in items:
                # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
                await save(item)
        break


async def return_outer(pages, items, session, save, cursor):
    for page in pages:
        async with session():
            for item in items:
                # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
                await save(item)
        return


async def sleep_outer(pages, items, session, save, cursor):
    for page in pages:
        async with session():
            for item in items:
                # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
                await save(item)
        await asyncio.sleep(0)


async def condition_outer(pages, items, session, save, cursor):
    while cursor:
        async with session():
            for item in items:
                # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
                await save(item)
        cursor = page.next


async def true_outer(pages, items, session, save, cursor):
    while True:
        async with session():
            for item in items:
                # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
                await save(item)


async def stream_outer(pages, items, session, save, cursor):
    async for page in pages:
        async with session():
            for item in items:
                # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
                await save(item)
